03.note: D42 closes the gap D26 opened. The app connects as swingsage_app (NOINHERIT, no superuser, no BYPASSRLS, not a member of service_role) and every query goes through withUser() - a transaction that sets request.jwt.claims and `set local role authenticated`, both reverting on commit. The ambient db export is DELETED (src/db/client.ts is gone); the data modules take the transaction as their first argument. withUser asserts four properties against the live connection and refuses to serve otherwise - verified by pointing APP_DATABASE_URL at the owner, which fails 11 of 12 boundary tests naming the role. app.ensure_profile() (SECURITY DEFINER, identity from auth.uid() internally, in a schema PostgREST does not serve) removes the last elevated write from a request path; Supabase's advisor caught it while it was in public and anon could call it over REST. Also found: the hosted project was three migrations behind (0005/0006/0007 local-only), now applied - both databases agree at ten tables, RLS forced, 2 policies each, zero advisor findings. Carried forward deliberately: one Supabase project rather than three (D10, money, step 10) and the analyzer service role unscoped to specific tables (defined by the analyzer-service track).
